examples.input: Patient management system for a multi-doctor family practice clinic
Telemedicine platform with video consultations, e-prescriptions, and follow-ups
Pharmacy inventory and dispensing system with drug interaction alerts
Mental health tracker with mood journaling, therapy session booking, and progress charts
Lab results portal where patients view test results with reference ranges
Dental practice management with treatment plans, X-ray storage, and insurance claims
Vaccination record system for schools with parent consent and reminder notifications
Hospital bed management system with real-time occupancy and transfer requests
Sports medicine clinic with injury tracking, rehab plans, and athlete performance
Home care coordination platform for elderly patients with caregiver scheduling
Weight loss clinic with meal planning, progress tracking, and coach check-ins
Blood bank management with donor tracking, inventory, and compatibility checks
Physiotherapy clinic with exercise videos, home program assignment, and outcome tracking
Medical education LMS for residency programs with case libraries and assessments
Occupational health program for employers with work injury tracking and fitness-for-duty assessments
